body:
# CobbleHelx

![COBBLEHELX Title Graphic. It has blue hues along the letters with pink butterfly accents.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c2ced94ddf952fa1d8d47ec1f20c3741bc78cfd5.png)
### For CobbleHelx Modpack
[Get it here.](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cobblehelx-modpack)
We'll always run the latest version.

Welcome to the Helx Universe.
(Trailer Coming Soon)

**CobbleHelx** is a [Cobblemon](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon)-focused server built around exploration, building, and multiplayer gameplay. This server prioritises exploring, building, capturing Pokémon and Hamsters using decoration mods, quality-of-life improvements, optimisation mods, and custom Helx content from the [CobbleHelx Relics](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblehelx-relics) mod) to create a more immersive experience without straying too far from vanilla-style progression.

Travel through large biomes, build towns with friends, collect Cobblemon, and shape your own adventure within the growing Helx Universe.

## About Helx
[Helx](https://helx.two-way.eu/) is the fictional universe created for projects **by Two Way Europe, our non-profit organisation**. It serves as the foundation for the stories, lore, regions, items, mechanics, and multiplayer experiences featured across our projects and related creations. [More info Two Way Europe can be found here](https://two-way.eu/).

## SOCIAL INFO
- The community will always have say in the added and removed content.
- No Pay-to-win systems will be added.
- LGBTQIAA+ friendly
- Our Ambassadors will play and stream on this server and might ask you to join in events they run

## Whitelist Only
Because Two Way focuses heavily around positive behaviour online, we work exclusively witha  whitelist. You'll gain access through our [Discord Server](https://two-way.eu/go/discord).

## Content
At the core you'll be focussing on:
- Creatures and Pets from:
  - [Cobblemon](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon)
  - [Adorable Hamster Pets](https://modrinth.com/mod/adorable-hamster-pets)
- Dimensions:
  - [The Aether](https://modrinth.com/mod/aether)
  - [Deep and Darker](https://modrinth.com/mod/deeperdarker)
- Armors from:
  - [Armor of the Ages](https://modrinth.com/mod/armor-of-the-ages)
  - [Fantasy Armor](https://modrinth.com/mod/fantasy_armor)
  - And soon from Cobblehelx!
- Utility
  - [Icarus](https://modrinth.com/mod/icarus)
  - [HT's TreeChop](https://modrinth.com/mod/treechop)
  - [PokeNet (Cobblemon)](https://modrinth.com/mod/pokenet-cobblemon)
  - [Waystones](https://modrinth.com/mod/waystones)
- Rewards from:
  - [Bountiful](https://modrinth.com/mod/bountiful)
- World generation (using Large Biomes) will make sure rivers are connected and can easily be travelled through:
  - [WWOO](https://modrinth.com/datapack/william-wythers-overhauled-overworld-(datapack))
  - [WWOO Cliffs and Coves](https://modrinth.com/datapack/cliffs-and-coves)
  - [WWOO Navigable Rivers](https://modrinth.com/datapack/navigable-rivers)
  - [WWOO Towering Tepuis](https://modrinth.com/datapack/towering-tepuis)
  - [The Roads More Travelled](https://modrinth.com/mod/the-roads-more-travelled) feature

The server includes [Distant Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons), which can be disabled client side.

## Planned Additions
The modpack, server and custom mod is still actively growing. Planned additions include:
- more custom Helx content
- more cosmetics
- expanded decorative options
- additional gameplay systems
- deeper lore integration
- features like a future questing/progression book (planned, not yet implemented)

With love  
- SparkleCat
